start.body: And here comes the heroine of the week!
start.speaker: Bellgates

mission1.body: At the same time as the massacre in the theater, there was an assault on the research facility.
mission1.speaker: Bellgates

complex_answer.body: What kind of facility? ...or is the question indiscreet?
complex_answer.speaker: Strikely

complex1.body: No. The question isn't indiscreet. But the answer could be.
complex1.speaker: Bellgates

complex2.body: I think, under the circumstances, we can disregard the NDA. It would be better if Strikely find out about the "immoral" experiments on clones now from us than later from terrorists.
complex2.speaker: Assistant Sparkle

complex3.body: The facility produces clones. These clones are used to test sent drugs and devices that would otherwise have to be tested on regular ponies.
complex3.speaker: Bellgates

complex4.body: Often all sorts of sleeping pills and antidepressants are tested on clones. More rarely, innovations like microwave oven.
complex4.speaker: Bellgates

complex5.body: Sometimes an RadAway is tested, whose effectiveness cannot be tested without infecting the clone with radiation sickness. Unfortunately.
complex5.speaker: Bellgates

complex6.body: But nothing more. No biological weapons. No super soldiers.
complex6.speaker: Bellgates

complex7.body: The last thing tested before the assault is StealthBuck, a device that will allow you to stealthily complete your mission even if you're not at all good at stealth.
complex7.speaker: Bellgates

complex8.body: Strikely, what do you think of this?
complex8.speaker: Bellgates

complex8_answer_2.body: It's better to sacrifice clones instead of ponies to progress.
complex8_answer_2.speaker: Strikely

complex8_answer_3.body: My job is to follow orders, not worry about ethics.
complex8_answer_3.speaker: Strikely

clones_answer.body: What do the clones themselves think about it?
clones_answer.speaker: Strikely

clones1.body: They're satisfied. In the decades of the facility's operation, there hasn't been a single escape attempt or rebellion from the clones themselves.
clones1.speaker: Bellgates

clones2.body: We even take too good care of the clones. There is always someone getting too attached to the clones.
clones2.speaker: Bellgates

clones3.body: Conducting tests with a high risk of irreversible injury is often accompanied by staff turnover, information leaks and an invasion of activists-terrorists who know suspiciously large amount.
clones3.speaker: Bellgates

clones3_answer.body: I suggest return to the current activists-terrorist.
clones3_answer.speaker: Bellgates

stealthbuck_answer.body: Can you tell me more about the StealthBuck?
stealthbuck_answer.speaker: Strikely

stealthbuck1.body: Personal device that generates a modulating refraction field. Using it effectively renders the wearer virtually invisible to the untrained eye.
stealthbuck1.speaker: Bellgates

stealthbuck2.body: The field works a little longer than a minute. The field is fragile and will irreversibly break if you shoot or change clothes from inside it.
stealthbuck2.speaker: Bellgates

stealthbuck3.body: One prototype is here with Assistant Pie. You can request it from her.
stealthbuck3.speaker: Bellgates

stealthbuck4.body: The fleeing colleagues managed to take one experimental prototype with them. You will be given it upon arrival.
stealthbuck4.speaker: Bellgates

stealthbuck5.body: The last prototype remained on the second floor of the facility, the same floor where the hostages are.
stealthbuck5.speaker: Bellgates

back_to_mission.body: All right, then. Back to the mission.
back_to_mission.speaker: Bellgates

mission2.body: While the attackers were breaking through to the second floor, the staff of the facility were already sneaking through the secret passages to the exit. By the time the attackers caught two hostages, the complex had already been cordoned off by operatives.
mission2.speaker: Bellgates

mission3.body: Your mission is to free these two hostages. Ideally stealthily, without unnecessary bloodshed.
mission3.speaker: Bellgates

mission3_answer.body: Why the sudden mercy for terrorists?
mission3_answer.speaker: Strikely

mission4.body: In return for your fire, the terrorists may open fire on the hostages – two key scientific staff members of the complex whose lives are best not to be risked.
mission4.speaker: Bellgates

mission5.body: The blueprints and prototypes can be reproduced, but the minds that designed them cannot.
mission5.speaker: Bellgates

terrorists1.body: In the negotiations, they identify themselves as clone rights activists. They claim they seized the facility to free the clones. They claim the theater massacre was carried out by their splinter radicals.
terrorists1.speaker: Bellgates

terrorists2.body: Fleeing personnel say the terrorists were more trying to get deep into the lower floors than shooting anything alive.
terrorists2.speaker: Bellgates

terrorists3.body: The terrorists are making contact. In particular, it has been possible to agree with them on the supply of fodder.
terrorists3.speaker: Bellgates

terrorists4.body: The raid has gone on so long that the terrorists have already eaten their supplies. The compound's storage facilities are beyond their reach, and the hostages will be the first to starve.
terrorists4.speaker: Bellgates

terrorists5.body: We agreed to supply fodder because it would give us an opportunity to plant a wire. Then we found out that the terrorist coming to the operatives camp for supplies were also planting a wire. So we started putting laxatives in their forage.
terrorists5.speaker: Bellgates

terrorists6.body: All the while, negotiations are underway to free the hostages in exchange for the release of the terrorists trapped on mid floors. But something tells me that even these negotiations will end with both sides sneakily ambushing each other at the same time.
terrorists6.speaker: Bellgates

terrorists7.body: And yet, the actions of the "liberals" so far correlate with their words.
terrorists7.speaker: Bellgates

situation_answer.body: Tell more about the current situation in the facility.
situation_answer.speaker: Strikely

situation1.body: Emergency door locking is still activated in the facility, you cannot move normally without key cards. Elevator access is still limited to the first two floors. Some of the terrorists are still trapped on mid floors.
situation1.speaker: Bellgates

situation2.body: There are more operatives. They're better equipped. They're probably better trained. In open combat, the terrorists don't stand a chance. However, the operatives cannot go in for an assault, for then the terrorists might kill the hostages.
situation2.speaker: Bellgates

situation3.body: It's a sandwich. At the very bottom are the clones the terrorists are trying to reach, the operatives are besieged. Everyone's holding each other by the tails and manes. No one can move.
situation3.speaker: Bellgates

situation4.body: To break the stalemate, we need a small pony that can fit in a supply crate. A pony so harmless-looking that the terrorists won't see her as a threat, but as a new hostage. A pony that has already rolled up a theater full of terrorists in one muzzle. That pony is you, Strikely Cloud.
situation4.speaker: Bellgates

situation4_answer.body: But I've never done stealth missions before.
situation4_answer.speaker: Strikely

place1.body: A future vault for storing and training backup-clones of a special agent. Potentially your backup-clones.
place1.speaker: Bellgates

place2.body: You can't access the storage yet, but you can take a drill from Miss Assistants. We'll find out how effective they are.
place2.speaker: Bellgates

assistants_answer.body: Why do your Miss Assistans look like M6?
assistants_answer.speaker: Strikely

assistants1.body: They also think like the M6.
assistants1.speaker: Bellgates

assistants2.body: Communicating with my pony version, has shown that our thoughts match at 92.8%. That's about 42 minutes before the first discrepancy in reasoning.
assistants2.speaker: Assistant Sparkle

assistants3.body: Twilight after a lengthy conversation with Assistant Sparkle appointed her as her representative. If you want her opinion, you can ask her robot-clone's opinion.
assistants3.speaker: Bellgates

assistants3_answer.body: Let me rephrase my question. Why do you need robo-clones of M6?
assistants3_answer.speaker: Strikely

assistants4.body: Prime-Minister Sparkle is more at ease when there are at least some backups of her and her closest friends, the bearers of the elements of harmony.
assistants4.speaker: Bellgates

assistants5.body: She entrusted me with the development of the robo-clones, their testing and their storage.
assistants5.speaker: Bellgates

assistants5_answer.body: Why aren't robo-clones made in pony form?
assistants5_answer.speaker: Strikely

assistants6.body: So that there are no ethical dilemmas. So that we understand who we are. So that when the Phoenix program moves on to the next stage, it will be easier to dispose of us.
assistants6.speaker: Assistant Sparkle

assistants7.body: And with manipulators instead of hooves, it's a lot easier to work in the lab с:
assistants7.speaker: Assistant Sparkle

phoenix2.body: The moment a pony kick the bucket, her clone will awaken with a completely indeterminate body, mind, and memories.
phoenix2.speaker: Bellgates

phoenix3.body: We've already practiced growing a pony in a flask. We've managed to digitize the memory. We've successfully transferred memories from one clone to another. We've safely copied the personality of a real pony into a robot, and more than once. We've perfected growing an exact copy of an already formed organism.
phoenix3.speaker: Bellgates

phoenix4.body: All that's left is to directly make backup-cloning of the real pony.
phoenix4.speaker: Bellgates

phoenix5.body: It's all calculated. It's all checked and double-checked. The risks are virtually nonexistent. Even found a candidate for a debut backup-cloning.
phoenix5.speaker: Bellgates

phoenix6.body: Right now I'm looking at her.
phoenix6.speaker: Bellgates

base1.body: Assistant Pie will teach you stealth tactics and can give you a StealthBuck.
base1.speaker: Bellgates

base2.body: When you are ready, I will give you a thorough briefing on mission strategies.
base2.speaker: Assistant Sparkle

base3.body: Assistant Apple will teach you how to use a tranquilizer gun.
base3.speaker: Bellgates

base4.body: You can get the tranquilizer itself from Assistant Shy.
base4.speaker: Bellgates

base5.body: Assistant Rarity will give you a stealth suit.
base5.speaker: Bellgates

base6.body: Assistant Dash... she is just making a fuss so far. I mean, guarding the perimeter, yeah.
base6.speaker: Bellgates

base7.body: And I will teleport you to the facility on van.
base7.speaker: Bellgates

cloning1.body: By completing this mission you will prove that your feat in the theater was no accident.
cloning1.speaker: Bellgates

cloning2.body: This would make you the perfect candidate to debut the Phoenix system.
cloning2.speaker: Bellgates

cloning3.body: If backup-cloning succeeds, you will be quasi-immortal, Equestria will have the backup-clones of the talented special agent, and we won't have to wonder what to do with those backup-clones.
cloning3.speaker: Bellgates

cloning4.body: If something goes wrong, which is extremely unlikely, then... Well, Equestria only found out about Strikely Cloud a week ago and was functioning normally before that.
cloning4.speaker: Bellgates

cloning5.body: But without your will, we're not at liberty to put you in the Phoenix program.
cloning5.speaker: Bellgates

cloning5_answer_1.body: My clones won't be sacrificed to science, will they?
cloning5_answer_1.speaker: Strikely

cloning7.body: And if there was, your clones would be lousy test subjects, they could take out an entire building full of thugs in one muzzle!
cloning7.speaker: Bellgates

cloning5_answer_2.body: I'll tell you my will after the mission.
cloning5_answer_2.speaker: Strikely

end1.body: Good. Then get ready for your mission. I will continue to monitor the situation in the facility.
end1.speaker: Strikely
